metadata.description: Marketplace for video-recreation-skill: a model-agnostic workflow for recreating viral short videos (e-commerce / folklore / AI drama)

plugins.name: video-recreation
plugins.description: Recreate viral short videos: shot decomposition (ASR/OCR/audio analysis) → script rewrite → keyframe & video generation → five-level visual QC → FFmpeg assembly, with character/product consistency anchors to stop AI face & product drift. Includes 285 e-commerce video prompt templates. By FrameFlow (yimiagent.cn).
